Once Focus 10 is familiar to you, you don't need the full count to return to it.
Inhale deeply. As you hold your breath, think the number ten, inside a bright, moving circle.
Exhale, and you'll be in Focus 10, just as you are right now.
Returning is just as quick. Think the number one, and intend to be awake.
Do this, and you'll be completely awake, both physically and mentally, refreshed, in every way.
The more you use these, the faster and more natural they'll become.
Return to Focus 12, and reinforce it. Let your consciousness expand even further, deeper, well beyond your five physical senses.

In this expanded state, you're free to explore however you choose. Set new patterns for your life. Reopen a communication point with someone. Practice nonverbal communication. Or simply observe and experience.
Use this time however serves you. I'll call you when it's done.
Calm and comfortable, back in Focus 12.

steps.text: Say in your mind. Say to yourself.
I am much more than my physical body. It is my intent, through these explorations beyond physical matter reality, to contribute to the expansion of human consciousness.
In consciously experiencing and acquiring knowledge of realms beyond ordinary consciousness, I will work to bridge these realities.
In so doing, I ask for help — to be open, allowing, and calm, and perceiving clearly, responding appropriately, and carrying out my intent of service.
I am truly grateful for this assistance. I set forth empowered by the energetic field of my fellow explorers, and acknowledgement of our oneness in love.

I am more than my physical body, because I am more than physical matter. I can perceive that which is greater than the physical world.
I deeply desire to expand. To experience. To know. To understand. To control.

This session is set to verbosity three. Every level named, and what is known about each of them.
What has been written about it: [[destinationPublished]]
The way there passes through [[stations]], and takes about [[duration]].
None of this is a prescription. It is a description of where we are going, offered so that you can recognise it if you arrive.
When you are ready, we begin.
This session is set to verbosity one. Anchors and counts, with room between them.
This session is set to verbosity two. The climbs, and a description of each place you arrive.
Nothing is required of you along the way. Notice what is there, and let the rest be.
You are now ready to create your Resonant Energy Balloon. A moving field of your own energy that surrounds and protects you.
Let the energy you've built rise gently out the top of your head, like a fountain cascading down and around your body, spiralling gently as it descends.
Some strands fall straight, others spiral clockwise, and some counterclockwise. Allow the energy to wrap around you completely, and re-enter through the soles of your feet.
You are now inside your own Resonant Energy Balloon.
This living energy field performs two important functions.
First. It holds in and concentrates your own energy, so you can direct it as needed.
Second. It protects you from external energies, unless you consciously open to receive them.
Take a moment now to feel its strength and softness. Feel how it supports and surrounds you.
To recreate your REBAL at any time. Inhale deeply. Visualise a circle with the number ten inside.
Then exhale, and imagine blowing that circle outward around you. Your balloon will instantly form again.
To dissolve it, simply inhale, and imagine the glowing circle returning into your body.

That overview calls Focus 11 the Access Channel. It associates the level with directing physical, mental, and emotional functions, and with access to the Total Self.
Treat that as a proposition to test, not a result to reproduce.
Observe what is actually present for you, without forcing it to match the map.
Remember what you notice. Your attributed account may confirm, amend, or reject what the overview says.
You are now in Focus 12. A state of awareness far beyond your physical body. Relax, and explore. You are safe, calm, and aware.
Rest here a moment. Let the absence of time settle around you.
No tape or manual in this library describes this level. The available description comes from public summary material, so hold it lightly.

Treat that as a proposition to test, not a feeling you are required to produce.
Observe what is actually present for you, without forcing it to match the description.

The way ahead has been cleared for your passing. There is little to see here. It is a transition. A quiet bridge. You need not linger.
This area is heavily populated, though only a small part of those here are conscious the way you are right now.
Some have altered their awareness through substances, or through injury — not fully conscious, their perception of the physical distorted.

Others are millions of people in ordinary physical sleep. Only part of their awareness has come here. Most aren't in control of what they're experiencing — they're running on patterns pulled straight from physical life, so completely that nothing else exists to them right now. Dreams. Dreaming.
You won't interrupt them if you move among them. You likely won't even perceive what they're dreaming — it belongs to each of them alone.
You're in full control here, whether or not they are. Observe, if you like. You're always free to move on toward Focus 23.
It is like a ghostly river around you. A slow drifting mist, with ripples and waves moving past at their own pace.
Ahead of you, a point of light. It's growing larger as you move toward it -- bright, but familiar, the kind of bright you get used to.
The light is large enough now to move into. When you're ready, continue forward.

Tall structures rise on either side of the path of light you travel. Each one houses a belief system. A religion, a philosophy, a worldview. Built and inhabited by those who hold to it. They stretch high above you, lining the way.
You are not stopping here. You move past them on the path of light. Notice them, but do not enter. Continue forward.
The void. There is nothing here, and nothing is required of you here. Pass through.
You are now in Focus 27. Known as The Park.
You arrive in the gardens of the Reception Centre. Take a moment to look around.
This place is real in the way that matters. It has been here, waiting, and it will be here when you return. The grounds are open. The air is clear. There is space.

Behind you, the Reception Centre itself stands open. This is where you can come to engage with the inhabitants of this locale. To meet others, to socialise, to find activity, to ask for guidance, or to simply be among presence. It is always here. You are always welcome.
But the Reception Centre is not your destination today.

steps.text: In later sessions, Focus 3 is a brief signpost on the way to Focus 10. Here, for your first visit, simply notice this light relaxation and the more coherent pattern of mind and brain.
Behind you, the Park at Focus 27. Ahead, Focus 35, and further gathering beyond.
This is a place of gathering. Others may be present, drawn from further than the physical universe accounts for. You may notice them, or you may not — either is a complete visit.
If you do notice presence, there is no requirement to engage. Approach it the way you'd want to be approached: gracefully, without demanding anything.
If anything here feels difficult to hold, perception tends to respond to intention more directly than it does at home. A shift in thought can be enough to change what you're perceiving.
If you feel unmoored, give yourself something ordinary to hold onto. Anything familiar will do. It's often enough to bring things back to steady.
What's written here is drawn from one visit, not a settled description. Let your own account, if you keep one, stand beside it rather than under it.

steps.text: As you sit, breathe into your chest. On the exhale, let the light of the campfire brighten, just a little.
You are sending a signal. Not with words, but with presence.
Say inwardly. I am here. I welcome connection.
Your flame glows softly in answer. Others may see it, feel it, sense it.
Let this signal radiate out into the surrounding area.

steps.text: Before you depart, take a moment to acknowledge those who joined you.
Offer thanks for their presence, in whatever way feels natural. No words are necessary. Intent is enough.
Now, turn your attention back to the fire.
Watch as the flames begin to fold in upon themselves. The light dims, the heat fades, and the entire fireplace resets.
The void absorbs it back into nothingness. In its place, a new unlit fireplace forms. Clear, and untouched.
It shimmers for a moment like a mirage, then ripples away into silence.
The space is reset, and left just as you found it.

steps.text: Now that the fire burns steadily, sit with it. You have made yourself visible. You are here.
If contact comes, you will feel it. Not as a thought, but as a presence. It will draw your attention in a way you cannot ignore.
Like a shout without volume. Like a single footstep in silence. It may feel like a tension in the space, a weight that wasn't there before.
You may sense where it comes from, just as you know where a sound originates even when you cannot see it.
This is not about imagining, or trying to know. It is about noticing what arrives on its own.
Rest here, with the fire before you, until the experience feels complete.

steps.text: You find yourself in the quiet void of the starfield of reality.
In this exercise, you will light a campfire. An invitation to any individuals equal to or greater than yourself, who may wish to join you.
The fireplace is prepared before you, the wood neatly stacked and waiting.
Kneel down and see the small box of matches lying there for you. Slide it open. Take a match. And light it.
Hear the sharp scratch, see the flare of light.
Guide the flame into the waiting timber. Lean close, blow gently, and watch as the small spark grows into a steady fire.
The campfire is now lit. A beacon of presence and connection.
Feel the warmth of the flames brushing against your skin.
Hear the gentle crackle and pop as the wood begins to burn.
Notice the faint smell of smoke curling into the night air.
Watch how the firelight flickers and bends, casting soft shadows that move across the ground.
When you feel the fire burning steadily, take your place nearby. Sit comfortably, and let its glow settle you here and now.
The beacon is lit. You are present. Now let others approach in their own time.

steps.text: Your place can take on another form: The Castle. An educational and research edition of what is already yours.
Let it grow, if you wish it to. Let it become a structure — a castle, if that is the shape that fits. You are not required to picture it in detail. Let it arrange itself.
This is a space for co-working. Entities and individuals — equal to you, or further along than you, in power, in development, in experience — may be met with here.
You set the terms, the same as always. Approach gracefully. Demand nothing. Be present. Let your intuition lead more than your expectation does.
The castle has many rooms. Each one is larger inside than it appears from without.
Each room holds whatever might be needed, on a whim — for testing, for exploring, for simulating, for exchanging creativity, energy, and information, between whoever is present in it.
Some rooms you will not enter. That is not exclusion. In those rooms, a version of you is already at work.
Think of it as a system running many processes at once, each one handled by a separate core, or a separate thread — the same you, in parallel, doing what does not fit in one place at one time.
Or think of it as compartments, each one sealed from the others by design and not by accident. What happens in one need not be known to the rest, and the whole still functions.
You do not need to visit every room to benefit from what happens in them. You do not need to understand the architecture. You only need to be here, in the room you are in.
Walk the halls if you wish. Or stay where you arrived. Either is the castle working as intended.
Stay as long as feels right.
Say in your mind, and say to the farthest areas of your perception.
I open this channel of communication only to those whose knowledge, wisdom, development, and experience are equal or greater than my own.
I restrict such contact and communication to constructive purpose, and reject all other.
I open such channel only when I so consciously desire. At all other times, it will remain closed.
Before we go further, one more thing that's always yours to use.
If the experience ever feels clouded, or fogged, or harder to hold onto than it should be, you have a technique for that. Think: clear skies.

Clear skies changes the field around you the way it changes any weather here. What you hold in mind is what continues. Used this way, it dispels interference and lets the experience carry on, with less between you and it.

If that isn't enough on its own, there's a second step. Send out a single, deliberate pulse — not force, coherence. It settles the field around you, and steadies whatever is underway so it can continue without interruption.

And if you'd rather not continue at all, you always can eject. Return to Focus 1, and the channel closes behind you, at least for now. This is never a failure. It's a door, and it stays unlocked from your side.
None of this is a sign of danger. It's a sign you're steering.
Carry this with you as you go. Nobody, and nothing, can harm you here. They may try to make you believe they can — that belief is the only lever they have.
The part of you doing the steering knows more than you can perceive right now, and isn't asking your permission to be capable. Trust it.
To take another step along the path.
I will guide you to Focus 3, the starting point of the Gateway Experience.

Let the number mark the change, and let your own observation supply the account.

Focus 12. Where your awareness moves far beyond the limits of your physical body. Far beyond physical perception.
To reach Focus 12, all you need do is count slowly in your mind from ten to twelve. When you reach the number twelve, you will be in Focus 12. A state of expanded awareness.
Eleven. Your awareness is expanding, reaching outward, more and more.
Now, you will move from Focus 12 into another state of being. Focus 15.
Focus 15 is the state of no time. A state not limited by time or space.
Because the energy that you are is beyond time, it is not controlled by time, and it can move freely.
To reach Focus 15 from Focus 12, all you need do is count up slowly in your mind to fifteen. Express the desire to be in no time, and you will move into that state.
I will count for you now.
Thirteen. You are moving out of the area of time, more and more.
Fourteen. You are moving into the state where time has no meaning. You remain calm and serene.
Fifteen. You are now in Focus 15. The state of no time. Where time does not exist.
From Focus 15, you will move through the count to Focus 18.
The available secondary map associates Focus 18 with unconditional love energy. No tape or manual here establishes what the transition should feel like.
Let the numbers mark the change. Observe the transition itself without trying to produce the description in advance.
From Focus 15, we continue the climb. The next state is Focus 21. The threshold between the physical and the non-physical.
You will move beyond Focus 21 as I count.
You are changing. Less aware of time and space, and more aware of this other state.
So close to time and space, but not part of it.
Focus 22. Relax, and remain calm, serene, and sure. You and your consciousness are in full control.
As you move, remain fully conscious and under complete control.
Before you is a tiny pinpoint of light. Look for it.
When you perceive it, focus your attention on that speck of light.
With your attention on the speck of light, move in the direction of that light.
The light is getting larger and larger. It is very bright, but you get used to it because it is familiar to you.
The path of light continues, and the structures fall away behind you.
Ahead of you in the void, a small white dot appears.
It begins to glow. Faintly at first.
It grows brighter. And brighter. And larger, expanding to meet you.
From Focus 27, you will move through the count to Focus 34.

The public map names Focus 34 and 35 together as the Gathering. One attributed account also describes a gathering and a dark starfield, but does not reliably separate what occurred at 34 from what occurred at 35.
Carry those as maps, not requirements. You do not need to perceive a presence, a gathering, or any particular scene.
Let the numbers mark the movement, and observe what is actually present.
You will move now from Focus 34 to Focus 35.
Public material describes 34 and 35 together as one Gathering region. One attributed account places a ceremony further out, but does not establish a clear border between the two levels.
Let the next number become an observation point. Notice whether the vantage changes, and do not force a distinction if none is present.
From Focus 35, you will move through the count to Focus 42.
The available secondary map associates Focus 42 with the solar system, our galaxy, and what it calls our I-There. No tape or manual here establishes what this movement should feel or look like.
Carry those as coordinates, not requirements. Let the numbers mark the movement, and observe what is actually present.
From Focus 42, you will move through the count to Focus 49.

The available secondary map associates Focus 49 with exploration beyond our galaxy, I-There clusters, and what it calls the Cluster Council. No tape or manual here establishes what this movement should feel or look like.
Carry those as coordinates, not requirements. Let the numbers mark the movement, and observe what is actually present, including any absence.
Three ways to use color, on a single breath. Learn them here; they are for later, in ordinary waking life, whenever you need them.
The first reduces an emotional charge, down to where it is no longer harmful. You close your eyes, inhale deeply, and hold the breath, thinking of calming, cleansing green.
As you exhale slowly, the green pushes the excess charge down through your body and out through the soles of your feet, leaving you calm, confident, and serene.
The second charges your body for strength, speed and coordination before a physical act. You inhale, hold the breath, think of the act, then the strong energy of red.
When you exhale and open your eyes, you will perform it stronger, faster, and more coordinated than before.

The third helps any part of your body toward balance. You inhale, hold the breath, and think of cool, healing purple. With your eyes closed you look at the part that needs it, and send the purple there, saying in your mind: heal, balance.
When you exhale and open your eyes, that part begins restoring itself immediately, more completely than before.
The more you use any of these, the easier and more effective they become.

Before we begin, take a moment to make yourself comfortable. Let your body rest in a way that feels supported, either lying down or seated in a chair that allows your back to relax and your shoulders to fall away from tension.
The goal isn't to fall asleep, but to become still enough that you could.
Now, in Focus 12, reach out and perceive communication from those who know, understand, and love you. Do it the nonverbal way — translating each word into a thought, and perceiving whatever answers.
Continue the exchange, in your own way. I'll call you when it's time to return.
You'll remember this in detail, and be able to put it into words once you're back.
Move now from Focus 12 to Focus 10.
Firstly, bring to mind your Energy Conversion Box. Picture it clearly. A large, strong container with a heavy lid that can hold anything you place inside.
Begin placing into the box everything that may interfere with your experience today. Thoughts, distractions, leftover tension. Worries, whether physical, emotional, or mental, all belong in the box.
If it helps, place your entire physical body into the box for now. You are not abandoning it. You're simply letting it rest.
Once you've placed everything inside, close the heavy lid, and gently turn your attention away.
Move your intention to the Coordination Area -- dedicated to maintaining and managing Focus 27 itself. Meet the energy beings who do that work. You're free to ask questions, and to listen.
Ask them about the inception, the creation, the history of Focus 27.
Ask how their management and coordination is actually carried out here.
Ask about Focus 27's relationship to the physical Earth system.
Ask what other systems, besides Earth, they're responsible for coordinating.
Ask what lies beyond -- what graduates of Earth School might choose next, for further growth or service. What possibilities are there?
And finally, ask for insight into Earth's own status as a developing system. Ask to perceive its stages, and something of where it's heading.
Give thanks for what you've learned. Make the intention to remember it.
You'll now return from Focus 15 to Focus 12.
You're now back in Focus 12, the state of expanded awareness.
Now, express gratitude for all you've perceived, received, and aligned with.
You'll now return from Focus 27, counting slowly back, down through each state in turn, all the way to Focus 10.
You're now back in Focus 12, the state of expanded awareness.
In Focus 12, let your consciousness expand even further. Deeper, well beyond your five physical senses.
Remember a time you just knew something was true, with no evidence for it. A hunch. A gut feeling. Maybe you even acted on it.
Recreate that memory now, as vividly as you can.
Now remember the feeling that came with that knowing. Let yourself feel it again, clearly.
Bring to mind other times you felt that same particular feeling. Recreate those too, as fully as you can.
Now let the images fade. Just keep the feeling.
That feeling is your own personal marker for intuition — a knowing you can trust.
This ability is natural to you. It's part of who you already are.
From now on, whenever you want to know something clearly: inhale, remember that feeling, and say in your mind — plus know now. Plus know now. Then exhale.
Do this, and your perception opens beyond the five senses. You'll know what you need to know, and what to do about it.
The more you practice this, the easier and more effective it becomes.
Move your intention to the Educational Center of Focus 27 -- a place of teaching, instruction, training, and learning.
Observe what's around you. Notice the activities taking place. Let whatever impressions come, come.

Ask for a personal demonstration -- a personal experience of how learning happens here. Maybe a simulation, something to watch and apply. Maybe a specific skill, guided step by step. Maybe a lecture hall, a class, a reading room, a hall of records. Maybe a tutor, or a counselor, sitting with you directly.
However it comes, stay open to it. Ask for your own personal experience here.
Give thanks for what you've received. Make the intention to remember it.
Now, construct your first energy tool. Visualise a small spot of light — white, glowing, sparkling.
Stretch it out into a white line. Then thicken it into a straight, round bar of sparkling white light.
Look at it closely. Pick it up. Hold it. Feel the glowing energy, and move it around until you're familiar with it. This is your Energy Bar Tool.
Now make it change color. Sparkling orange.
And back now to sparkling white.
Hold it firmly. It's yours — you created it, and you control it.
Now make it flash. On, then off. Slowly at first.
Faster now. On and off, faster and faster, until you can no longer tell the moments it's off — until it looks like one solid, smooth bar of light again, even though it's still pulsing.
Now release the bar. Move back from it a little, and just feel the energy radiating from it. It's yours — become comfortable with it.
Release it fully, and let it float free. It will stay here, ready, whenever you want it again.
From Focus 12, here's a way to draw fresh energy directly into your system, whenever you want it.
Bring your center of consciousness into the palms of your hands.
Now let pure, white, radiant energy flow in from every direction of your expanded awareness — down into your palms, up through your arms, spreading through all of you. Refreshing. Invigorating.
Let it flow for as long as feels right.
Now let it close down. Bring your center of consciousness back to its normal place.
Relax, and notice how refreshed you feel.

From now on, whenever you want this: close your eyes, extend your hands palms-up, inhale deeply, and hold your breath. In that moment, picture the same radiant white energy centering on your palms and flowing up through you.
When you exhale and open your eyes, you will feel refreshed and rejuvenated, and you will no longer feel hunger for physical food, because your need has been satisfied.
The more you use this, the more strongly, rapidly, and surely your body responds to it — and the more effective it becomes, awake and waking.
Feel the vibrations of your second body, your energy body, surrounding your physical one. Take a moment with it.
Now, in Focus 12, notice those vibrations rising. Pulsing faster. More and more.
As you relax into this, notice yourself getting lighter. Lighter still. It's a good feeling — simply floating, inside your own energy body.
Now think of floating upward. Up. How nice it feels, lighter and lighter, gently floating up and away from your physical body.
Now, slowly and calmly, float back down. Toward your physical body. Feel the vibrations of your energy body slowing as you settle back into place.
Relax, and remember this freedom of movement.
From Focus 10, explore the process your body uses to fall into total sleep — a way to remember what that feels like, so you can call on it later.
Think how nice it would be to float. To float out and away. Calm. Serene.
Turn slowly, as if you were a log rolling in water.
Detach easily. Let yourself float upward, slowly, up and away. Calm and pleasant.
Notice how you feel right now. Remember it.
Now float back down, in the direction you came from. More, and more.
Turn again, as if you were a log rolling in water.
You're nearly back where you started.
Now you've returned, completely, to where you began.
Relax, and feel calm and comfortable in Focus 10. Remember what you've noticed.
From this moment on, whenever you want normal, natural, restful sleep, count slowly in your mind from one to twenty. When you reach twenty, you'll be there.
The more you use this, the easier and more effective it becomes.
Let this count carry the rest of the way. Eleven. Twelve. Thirteen. Fourteen. Fifteen. Sixteen. Seventeen. Eighteen. Nineteen. Twenty.
From here, reach in and ask for help — from the one within you who is your closest friend. The one who knows and understands you better than you realize. Your inner helper.
Keep stating your desire to meet and know this greater part of yourself, calmly and easily, until contact is made and communication begins.
Ask your inner helper: what is the relationship between the two of us?
Ask how your inner helper came into being.
Ask about any physical lifetimes this part of you may have lived.
Ask how many physical lifetimes you yourself have lived.
Ask what the three most important of those lifetimes have been.
Ask what the purpose is, of living a physical human life here, in earth, time, and space.
Ask what your own goal is, in living this physical life.
Ask how you can best achieve it.
Give thanks for what you've received. Release your inner helper for now, and close down the communication — with gratitude for the help and cooperation.
State that you'll resume again soon.

doc.title: Explore Total Self — The Inner Helper

steps.text: You're free to explore the far reaches of Focus 15 now. The nature of your own intuition. The creative energy within you. Your true essence. Or simply the stillness that lives deep inside you.
I'll call you when it's time to return, and you'll remember everything you find in detail.
In Focus 12, let your consciousness expand further still. Deeper, well beyond your five physical senses.
Express your intent to know yourself more fully as an intuitive being, and your relationship to the source of that intuition.
From this expanded place, look for any obstacles in you that get in the way of trusting yourself as intuitive. Ask for help identifying any limiting beliefs.
Now express your intent to release them. Let them drift up and away, one by one, easily and gently. Feel lighter as they go.
You're free now to go deeper — into communication with this wise, knowing part of you.
Express your sincere intent to know it more fully. Its relationship to you. Its own particular way of speaking to you.
Invite it to communicate. To answer a question, if you have one. To offer whatever's needed. Whatever's right for you, right now.
I'll call you when it's time to return.
From now on, whenever you want to know something clearly: inhale, remember your own unique feeling, and say in your mind — plus know now. Plus know now. Then exhale.
Do this, and your perception opens beyond the five senses. You'll know what you need to know, and what to do about it.
The more you practice this, the easier and more effective it becomes.
Give thanks now, for this deeper trust and awareness.
From your special place, move out into the park itself -- the walks, the gardens, the trees.
Ask for help in making a rescue run.
With that help beside you, move back to Focus 23.
Select someone newly arrived here -- with the one beside you helping. Take your time choosing.
Now begin escorting them back to the reception center, the way station at Focus 27. As you go, ask them about their most recent life. What name did they use? Where did they live? Learn what you can.
Continue the move to Focus 27 now.
You're in the park at the reception center. Ask your friend to bring the newcomer to whoever can help them best.
Say goodbye to them, warmly. Then return to your own special place.
Relax, and remember in detail what you've just done.
Now, practice freedom of movement — so you can move freely, wherever and whenever you desire.
First: imagine turning over, slowly, like a log rolling in water.
Keep rolling, slowly, all the way around.
Now slow down, and stop exactly where you began.
Second: imagine yourself as a long, straight, stiff pole, lying flat. The end that's your head begins to lift.
Slowly tilting upward, more and more, until you're fully upright.
Now tilt back down the way you came, slowly, until you're flat again — and relax. You're no longer the pole.
Third: imagine backing away from where you are right now, slowly and easily.
Keep moving back, until you can see the back of your own head, the back of your body.
Stop, and feel exactly where you are now.
Now return, moving forward slowly, until you can no longer see yourself because you're too close — and now you're back where you started.
Fourth: imagine an opening at the top of your head, and yourself flowing out through it, like a cloud.
Flowing outward, evenly, more and more, until you feel free — free enough to look back and see the top of your head from where you've flowed to.
Now flow back, through the top of your head, slowly and calmly, until you're back exactly where you started.
Fifth: imagine the feeling of floating upward, up and away from where you are.
Floating higher, more and more, until you can look down and see your physical body from where you're hovering.
Now float back down, slowly and calmly, until you're close enough that you can no longer see your body from outside it — you're back.
Relax. Breathe easily. You've returned each time, and you can always return.
From Focus 12, five important messages are waiting for you in the far reaches of your expanded awareness.

Some have been there always, just beyond memory. Others are things of vital importance you haven't been aware of. They may arrive as words, pictures, pure understanding, direct experience, or contact with someone else -- or all of these together. However they arrive, you'll receive, understand, and remember their value.
Ask now for your fifth message. Send the request out into your total awareness, and wait.
You'll understand and remember it, once you're back.
Ask now for your fourth message. Send it out, and wait.
You'll understand and remember it, once you're back.
Ask now for your third message. Send it out, and wait.
You'll understand and remember it, once you're back.
Ask now for your second message. Send it out, and wait.
You'll understand and remember it, once you're back.
Now, ask for your first and most important message. Send it out, and wait.
You'll remember and understand all five, carefully and thoroughly, once you're back.
From here, you'll ask five questions into this expanded awareness, and ask for help in receiving the answers.
The first question. Ask it, into the far reaches of your awareness: Who am I?
You'll remember the answer clearly, once you're back.
The second question. Where, and who, was I before I entered this physical being?
You'll remember and understand it, once you're back.
The third question. What is my purpose for this existence, in physical matter reality?
You'll remember the answer, once you're back.
The fourth question. What action can I now take, to best serve this purpose?
You'll remember and understand it, once you're back.
The fifth question. What is the content of the most important message I can receive and understand, at this point in my existence?
You'll receive full understanding of this one once you're fully awake, in physical matter reality.
You're in Focus 23 -- the transitional reality of those who've detached from physical life.
You remain calm and strong, because you're still in control of yourself, and you're still bound to physical life. You can return completely, at any point you choose.
Observe. Perceive those who've made the transition but don't yet recognize it.
Perceive those who realize something has changed, but keep trying to stay in physical life anyway.
Perceive those who are bewildered and lost -- because they don't understand the meaning of the change. Frightened. Angry. Not knowing what to be, or what to do.
Perceive those who've become isolated, immobile. Locked, shocked, unable to release -- drifting, waiting.
Observe all of this. Here is where the many can be helped.
For now, become familiar. Only perceive and observe -- you're under full control of yourself, so that you can come back here when you're ready to help.
Before you and around you are the expressions of every human belief about existence beyond time and space.
The more people who hold a given belief, the stronger its presence here. But even the smallest is real too -- held up by no more than a few.
You remain calm and conscious. You're here to observe, not to participate.
You may recognize people you know. You're only a visitor here -- here to observe, and to remember, and to carry the memory back with you.
Go and explore now, as a visitor. Take in the perspective this freedom gives you.
This is your own exercise, for whatever you came here to do.
Remember the purpose you set before you began. Now, in Focus 10, carry it out.
Remember your purpose for this exercise.
Here in Focus 12, you're free. Free to send out questions and receive answers. Free to find whatever communication or information you're looking for.
Explore. I'll call you when this period is done.
Begin moving back now to where you started.
As you do, give thanks for anything you've received or communicated with.
And close down any channels you've opened.
You're back now, at your starting point. Calm, comfortable, and relaxed in Focus 12.
Floating comfortably in your energy body, notice the light surrounding you. Warm. Soft. Comfortable.
Relax into it. Feel grateful for the comfort, the peace, the love you find here.
Now begin to move through the light, carrying that feeling with you. Moving toward Focus 21. More and more.
Relax, and feel calm and comfortable in Focus 21.
Beyond this light are those who know, understand, and love you -- willing to help you experience more of Locale 2. Ask for their guidance. Be open to receive.
Give thanks to those who've helped you. Know you can always reach them again -- all it takes is thinking of them, and their help is freely there.
Now it's time to return. Back to your starting point, back to your physical body. Back through the light, your energy body slowing as you go.
Settling back into place. More grounded. More here.
Relax, and remember what you've experienced.
Before you leave this place, take a moment.
Express your thanks and your gratitude toward the individuals and the entities you have been in touch with here.
Express gratitude for all you've perceived, received, and aligned with.
Move your intention to the Healing and Regeneration Center -- where new arrivals to Focus 27 recuperate, and receive healing, counseling, and guidance.
Observe what's happening here. Let any impressions come. Stay open.

Ask for a personal demonstration of how healing works here. Maybe it's physical -- healing, or strengthening your basic life force. Maybe it's emotional -- release, letting go of judgment, forgiveness of yourself, forgiveness of others.
Open to healing for this lifetime, and for others too, if that's what's offered. Ask for whatever healing, regeneration, or balance you're most in need of right now.
Give thanks for what you've received. Make the intention to remember it.

When you return to the conscious, physical, waking state, your body will be so equalized as to overcome all those things that might hinder or prevent it from being and giving its best mental, spiritual, and physical self.
The body physical will create within the system those properties necessary to cause the eliminations to be so increased as to bring the best normal physical condition for the body.
The mental will so give that impression to the system as to build the best moral, mental, and physical forces for your body.

The circulation will be so equalized as to remove strain from all centers of the nerve system, as to allow the organs of the system to assimilate and secrete properly those conditions necessary for normal conditions of your body.

The nerve supplies of the whole body will assume their normal forces. The vitality will be stored in them through the application of the physical being, as well as of the spiritual elements in the physical forces of the body.
Perfectly normal, perfectly balanced, and perfectly equalized will be the condition when you return to the physical waking state.

You're going to meet the intelligence that maintains the physical Earth. Say in your mind: I access whatever state of awareness is best for understanding what I'm perceiving, quickly and without effort. I perceive exactly what's most useful for me right now.
Begin at the Earth's surface. Open your perception to the mineral kingdom -- stones, strata, gems. Explore its properties, its energies.
Now the plant kingdom. Flowers, trees, growing things. Explore its properties, its energies.
Now the animal kingdom. Insects, birds, fish, mammals. Explore its wildlife, its properties, its energies.
Now the four elements. Earth first -- explore it.
Now leave the surface behind, and dive in. Move through the layers, deeper, toward the very inner core of the Earth.
As you approach the core, notice a massive crystal -- six-sided, pointed at the poles, glistening like a giant diamond. Take in its facets.
Deep in this crystalline core, ask to meet the intelligence responsible for creating and maintaining the Earth. Use every sense. Ask: is there a message for me?
Still here in the core, shift your awareness to Focus 15. Notice how the core looks from this perspective.
Now Focus 27. Notice this perspective too.
From here, an encoding to return to this crystal any time you like: this is Earth Core 27. Inhale, and picture a six-sided crystal inside a globe. Exhale, and you'll be here again.
Give thanks for what you've learned and seen.
With your Resonant Energy Balloon formed around you, safe and floating, you're going to learn to let it move.
Let it float upward. Lighter, and lighter. Slowly and easily.
Hold it right there. Observe from where you're floating — safe, secure, calm.
Now let it descend, slowly, back to where you began.
Let it rise again — a little further this time than before.
Hold it. Observe this new height.
Descend again, slowly, back to where you started.
Once more — let it rise, further than either time before.
Hold, and observe in every direction from here.
Now descend, slowly and calmly, all the way back to where you began.
Let your Resonant Energy Balloon move inward now, and reabsorb into you — because it is you.
Relax, and feel calm and comfortable in Focus 10.
Now, another energy tool: your Living Body Map. Through it, you can directly balance and equalise the vital energies of your physical body.

Visualise the outline of your physical body in bright white light. Head, neck, shoulders, arms, hands, chest, back, stomach, hips, legs, feet. This white outline represents every energy factor in your body.
Now change the outline's color, one at a time. Red, for your circulation.
Yellow, for your organs and glands.
Orange, for your muscle and bone.
Back to bright, sparkling white — the composite of your body's total energy.
Now place this white map over your physical body. Notice any parts that look dim, or flickering.
Reach for your Energy Bar Tool, and charge it bright white.
Wherever your map shows dim or flickering, let purple healing energy flow from the tool into those parts.
Now bathe the whole map, head to feet, in that same purple — washing out anything that doesn't belong, recharging everything it touches.
Change your map to red again — circulation — and look for anything dim or flickering. Use the Energy Bar Tool's purple ray on it.
Back to white, then blue — your nerve system. Same again: purple, on anything dim.
Back to white, then yellow — organs and glands. Purple, on anything dim.
Back to white, then orange — muscle and bone. Purple, on anything dim.
Now let the map return to white — the total of your physical body.
Look deeper, just behind it. There's a second map — finer, thinner. Your emotional body.
Wherever it looks dim or flickering, brighten it with the same purple energy. Wherever it looks unusually, unevenly bright, use the tool to even it out — calm, serene, balanced.
Both maps are clean now. Turn away from them.
Release the Energy Bar Tool. Let it float free, somewhere you can find it again.
You're stronger now, physically and emotionally — and because of that, clearer and more awake mentally. Let your awareness be brighter, stronger, and clearer.
Move to the Planning Center now. Ask to meet with the entry director, and others who help prepare people for entry into physical earth life.
Make contact. Use every sense you have.
Ask to observe the process itself -- the steps in preparing to enter a physical body, a new human life. Notice anything that surprises you. Listen. Absorb.
Now ask to meet anyone here with direct knowledge of your own personal history -- anyone who knows you well.

With that contact made, ask for a review of your own entry into this life. What discussions took place? What choices did you make in preparing for it? What were you meant to learn from this lifetime? What guidance were you given? What were you feeling? What were your attitudes about it?
Let yourself fully experience this -- your entry into this life, and into others, if that's offered too.
You hear the ocean now. Birds overhead. The surf, gently leaving the shore.
You're standing on a warm, sunny beach -- somewhere familiar to you. Feel the sand under your feet. The sun's warmth. A gentle wind on your face.
Now feel a hand reaching for yours. You're moving higher, your awareness expanding, more and more.
Your loved ones are with you now. Their essence is woven into you, and always will be. The separation between you was only physical. Nothing more.
The one you wish to connect with is here with you now.
You'll see a ray of light -- pure, bright white, warm and pleasant, coming down from above. Feel it touch you.
Ask now, for a message. Something that matters to you.
And if you wish, send one back.
It's time to return. Express your love as you turn away, and let what you've received stay with you clearly.
Feel yourself moving back down, toward the sea. The waves at your feet again. The soft breeze.
Remember the message. And when you can, send them one of love in return.
Focus 15 is a state of creation and manifestation. Here, you can reach what is, and know that intent alone puts your creative ability into action.
Be in the stillness that exists deep within you — the stillness between thoughts themselves, without thought.
Now, in this stillness, feel the energy around you. You are not separate from it.
Open your heart. Open your mind. Whatever you want to create or manifest in your life is available to you here.
Focus on what you desire, or what you need. Be open to receive it.
You can return to this state simply by remembering the feeling of where you are right now.
From this point on, whenever you want to create a change or manifest a need in your life: inhale, remember this feeling, and say in your mind — plus create now. Plus manifest now. Then exhale.
Do this, and you activate your creative ability from within, with clear intent — manifesting what's needed for your higher purpose.
The more you practice this, the easier and more effective it becomes.
You're in Focus 21 -- the bridge. A bridge to other reality systems, other dimensions of Locale 2. A bridge that lets you visit, and return, from a realm beyond physical existence.
Relax, and notice the difference in energy here.
Now perceive a bright, shining pattern of white light. Move into it.
Move through the light now, calmly, and perceive what Locale 2 makes possible.
Notice the difference between where you were and where you are now.
Feel the energy moving through every cell of your physical body.
Say in your mind. I deeply desire the help and cooperation, the assistance, the understanding of those individuals whose wisdom, development, and experience are equal to or greater than my own.
I ask their guidance and protection. I ask that the light of their being, the light of their source, surround me and assist me in this exercise.
Now in Focus 12, ask for the assistance of four guides — guides you know and trust. Ask for their help with what you desire.
Feel them approaching. Two moving to one side of you, two to the other. Feel their presence, right there beside you.
Ask them to assist you. Feel the light of their being merge with yours — their support lifting you, further from your physical body.
Feel yourself moving upward, calmly, guided. Your energy body rising, more and more.
You're above your physical body now. Calm and secure, a guide on either side.
Now, gently, let them bring you back — back to Focus 12, back to the familiar.
Relax here, your guides still beside you.
Ask them again to help you move upward. Feel them lift you — higher this time. Confidently, you move with them, further from the physical.
You're free now. Explore. Simply be open to what's here.
Let your guides bring you gently back to Focus 12.
Express gratitude for all you've experienced. Let it radiate through you.
Here's your first exercise in NVC — nonverbal communication. Sending and receiving whole information without words: pictures, form, movement, color, energy, vibration, emotion.
To see why it matters: think of the word "glasses."

Your picture might have been eyeglasses, or drinking glasses, or window glass. Words need other words to fill in what they mean. If the information had come as NVC instead, you'd have known instantly and exactly what was meant — no filling in required. That's what you're building toward.
Start with something simple. Look with your closed eyes at the palm of your right hand.
Turn it over in your mind's view. Look at the back of your hand.
Let it go. Just hear my voice.
Now the palm of your left hand.
Turn it over in your mind's view. The back of your hand.
Now, the same way — picture each of these the moment you hear it, and release it the moment I say the next one.
Move now to Focus 12, the state of expanded awareness. Focus 12.
Reach out with your awareness, and perceive whatever nonverbal information is available — not words, but the wider kind. Pictures, movement, emotion, feelings you wouldn't otherwise notice.
You'll remember what you perceived in detail, and translating words into this fuller sense will come easier from now on. Take that with you, back to Focus 10.
Your next exercise in nonverbal communication. Same as before — picture each thing the moment you hear it, release it the moment the next one comes.
Now feelings and concepts, the same way.
Now restate your affirmation, nonverbally, one line at a time.
I am more than my physical body.
Because I am more than physical matter.
I can perceive that which is greater than the physical world.
Therefore, in these exercises, I deeply desire to expand.
To use such greater energies and energy systems as may be beneficial and constructive to me, and to those who follow me.
Also, I deeply desire the help and cooperation, the understanding, of those whose wisdom, development, and experience are equal or greater than my own.
I ask their guidance and protection from any influence or source that might provide me with less than my stated desires.
Move now to Focus 12 by the nonverbal method you've learned. Focus 12.
Use your expanded awareness to perceive whatever nonverbal information is available. I'll call you when it's time to return.
You'll remember it in full, and be able to put it into words once you're back.
Now, listen to the sound of the ocean surf. This is more than relaxation. This is energy.
A natural rhythm. A wave of motion and stillness, always present where sea meets the land.
You are made of similar waves. Your heart pulses in rhythmic bursts, and you breathe in soft, rising arcs. My voice reaches you through invisible vibrations that your ears translate into meaning.
All of this is energy. It flows through you constantly, often without your awareness. But from this moment on, you're learning how to feel it, shape it, and use it deliberately.
This is not something foreign or dangerous. It is your own life energy. It belongs to you, and no one else.
From Focus 12, you'll create new patterns in your total being -- each one, as it will be one year from today.

For each: think of the pattern as already complete, one year ahead, an active reality of your total self. Build it. Make it stronger, more and more. Then release it, and let it flow out strongly into every part of your expanded awareness, in every direction.
First, your physical body, one year from today. Build the pattern.
Now your mental self, one year ahead. Build it.
Now your emotional self, one year ahead. Build it.
Now your greater self, as you'll be one year from today. Build it.
Now where you'll be, one year from today. Build the pattern.
Now what you'll be doing, one year from today. Build it.
Now what you'll have achieved, one year from today. Build it.
You've created the total pattern -- who and how you'll be, one year ahead. Relax, and feel calm and comfortable.

doc.title: Opening — Toward Gathering

steps.text: This is the beginning of your journey. A quiet, personal path that starts in comfort and stillness.
Now, you should be hearing my voice in your right ear. If you're not, turn your headphones around so that you are.
From Focus 12, you'll create new patterns in your total being, one at a time.

For each one: think of the pattern as already complete — an active reality of your total self, doing and being exactly as you desire. Build it. Make it stronger, more and more. Then release it, and let it flow out strongly into every part of your expanded awareness, in every direction. The pattern leaves your center of consciousness and moves out into all of it.
First, your physical body. The pattern you'd like it to be. Build it.
Now your mental self. Build the pattern.
Now your emotional self. Build the pattern.
Now your greater self. Build the pattern.
Now where you desire to be. Build the pattern.
Now what you desire to do. Build the pattern.
Now what you desire to achieve. Build the pattern.
Relax, and know the pattern is complete — the one you've built for your own existence.
From the gardens, allow yourself to be drawn toward the place that is yours.
You may already know where it is. Or not. Either is fine. Move in the direction that feels right, and you will arrive.
This is your place. What is here belongs to you.
The physical limitations you know do not apply here.
Here, intention shapes what is perceived. Set what you want, see how it can be, and it is so. The place morphs in front of you, as you wish.
You may set a whitelist, naming those who are welcome. Or a blacklist, naming those who are not. You may invite specific individuals.
The systems are yours to design. The boundaries are yours to draw. This is your sovereign space.

And remember. When you wish company, when you wish to engage, when you wish to find activities or meet others, the Reception Centre is nearby. It is always nearby. You can return to it whenever you choose.
Move your intention to the Planning Center -- the place that oversees energy patterns in the Earth life system: introducing new ones, removing ones no longer useful, modifying others.
Observe. Ask to understand how new ideas and energy patterns get introduced into physical earth reality. Open your perception, and watch.

Now become part of the process. Ask to be given an idea here you can track, follow, or help bring into the physical -- a concept, an invention, a fragrance, an event, a musical theme, a scientific insight, a personal integration. Whatever comes, follow its course from Focus 27 into the Earth's energy pattern.

Now ask to observe another function here -- the uplink, monitoring everything that flows back from human earth consciousness, feeding into the record and into what happens next. Watch the streams of information return. Notice how they're received, considered, recorded.
With both directions in view -- what flows out to Earth, and what flows back -- ask what you can perceive about the larger plan. What's the grand design for how the planet continues to unfold?
Give thanks for what you've learned. Make the intention to remember it.
Calm and comfortable, floating in your energy body. Feeling lighter and lighter.
Slowly, think of turning over — the way you'd turn over in bed, from your back to your stomach. Either direction, whichever feels right.
Turn now. Notice there's no friction, no weight to it. Keep rotating, slowly, until you've turned a full hundred and eighty degrees.
Now, with your non-physical eyes, sense that you're face to face with your physical body. Recognise this position.
Calmly, think of floating upward. Up, and above your physical body.
Stay here, just above it, and observe. Perceive whatever there is to perceive in this new position.
Remember: what you've just done, you can do again. Remember the feeling of exactly where you are right now.
From now on, whenever you want to return to this state, all you need do is think of the feeling of vibration and expansion. You'll move calmly and confidently, right back to here.
The more you practice this, the easier and more effective it becomes.
Now, calmly, think of your physical body. Move back to it, simply by thinking of yourself, physical, and returning.
Move back until you feel the connection again.
Express gratitude now, for all you've experienced. Let it radiate through you.
From Focus 12, take the question or problem you brought with you.
Cast it out into your total awareness, and wait for the best answer to come back to you, clearly and distinctly.
You will consciously remember what you receive.
Now repeat it, for clarity. Send the same question out through your entire awareness once more, and wait for the answer.
You will consciously remember and understand the best answer you've received.

At any point in the future, when you're physically wide awake and want the best answer to a question, inhale deeply, pulling fresh energy into your head, and hold your breath. Think the number twelve, then the question.
Exhale, and you'll consciously know the best answer to what you presented.
The more you use this, the easier and more definite it becomes.
Now we move to the Focus 10 state. Mind awake. Body asleep.
I will count from one to ten. Nothing to do but hear the numbers.
Now we move to the Focus 10 state. Mind awake. Body asleep.
As I count from one to ten, you will relax each part of your body. By the time we reach ten, your body will be completely relaxed, and your mind will remain alert and aware.
First, let your jaw go limp and relax. Let the muscles and nerves in your jaw go limp and relax.
Now your eyelids. Let the muscles and nerves in your eyelids relax, and go limp.
Now your lips. Let the muscles and nerves in your lips relax. Relax easily, and go limp.
Now the muscles in your forehead. The muscles in your forehead. Let the muscles in your forehead relax. Go limp.
Now the muscles in your cheeks. Each cheek. Let them relax. Relax, and go limp. Relax.
Now the muscles in your scalp. The muscles in your scalp, over the top of your head. Let them relax. Relax.
Now the muscles in your neck. Let the muscles in your neck relax. Relax.
Now let the muscles in your eyes, the muscles that control your eyes. Let them relax. Relax.
Now let this relaxation of your head, of the muscles and nerves in your head, let it sink inward. Inward. Let it flow into your brain.
Let this relaxation of your head flow into your brain. Let it sink easily and deeply into your brain.

Feel it sinking inward, easily and calmly, until your entire brain feels more and more relaxed. More and more relaxed, as you feel the relaxation of your head sink inward, inward into the nerves of your brain, so that your brain feels relaxed.
Now that your brain feels and understands this relaxation, as I count to ten, let it flow from the brain. Let it flow from the brain into every part of your physical body.
Into your toes, into your feet, into your legs, into your hips. Into your lower body, into your upper body, into your back, into your fingers, into your hands, into your arms, into your shoulders.
Let it flow into these parts as I guide you in the count to the ten state. I'm going to count now.
Four. Look with your closed eyes at your feet and your toes. Your brain tells the muscles and nerves in each foot and each toe to relax, let go, sleep.
Five. Look with your closed eyes at your legs, at each leg, from your hip down to your foot. Your brain tells each leg to relax. Let go. Sleep.
Six. Look with your closed eyes at your hips, at each hip. Your brain tells each hip, the muscles and nerves in each hip, to relax, let go. Sleep.

Seven. Look with your closed eyes at your lower body. Your abdomen down to your hips, your kidneys, your liver, your stomach, your intestines, your genitals. Your brain tells all of these parts in your lower body to relax. Let go. Sleep.
Eight. Look with your closed eyes at your upper body. Your chest, your heart, your lungs, your diaphragm. Your brain tells these parts of your body to relax, let go, sleep.

Nine. Look with your closed eyes up and down your back. The muscles and nerves in your back. Your brain tells your back, up and down your back, the muscles and nerves in your back, to relax. Let go. Sleep.
Ten. Look with your closed eyes at your upper body. Your arms, your hands, your fingers, your shoulders. Your brain tells all of these parts to relax, let go, sleep.
Relax, and be calm and comfortable in Focus 10. The ten state, where your mind is bright and alert.
Your physical body is deeply, calmly, and comfortably asleep.
This is a practice for cleaning, balancing, and recharging what you're carrying.
From Focus 10, return to your Energy Conversion Box. Raise the lid, and look inside.
Find one radiation of fear. Just one — whatever surfaces first.
Pull it out of the box, and let it go. Up and away, like a bubble rising through water.
With that fear gone, look again. Underneath it was an emotion. Find it now.
Take that out as well, and release it the same way. Up and away, free of you, and you free of it. You won't need it again.
Now, free of the fear and the emotion that covered it, there's a memory left underneath — the event itself, clean of what was wrapped around it.
Calmly, retrieve that clean energy, and let it come back into you.
Close the box, and turn away.
Repeat this with each fear that surfaces, for as long as feels right.
Before we begin, sit up for a moment. You will need something to write on.
Write down what you intend to look for. A person, a place, an object, a moment in time. One line is enough.
Be as specific as you are willing to be. If you only have a question, write the question.
Now put it somewhere you can reach when this is over, face down, and leave it there.
That is the last thing you have to do awake. Lie down, and make yourself comfortable.
Reach out and find your Energy Bar Tool. Bring it close, and charge it with fresh energy.
Now reshape it. Change the bar into a tube of energy — you made it, so you can remake it.

Place one end close to your center of consciousness. Stretch the other end out, as far as you like, until it reaches the sealed envelope you're picturing — the one with a card inside, six numbers written on it.
Perceive through the tube. Read the six numbers, one at a time. You'll remember them clearly once you're back awake.
Now pull the tube back. Let it shrink to its normal size, and charge it again with bright white energy.
Change your tool back into a solid bar. Picture a white cotton ball in front of you.
Press the charged bar against it, and let energy flow out — making the ball lighter, and lighter, until it starts to float upward on its own.
Now cut the energy. Let the ball fall back down, and recharge your bar.
Try it again — touch the ball, send lifting energy, and let it float. Then cut the energy and recharge.

Now something different. Touch the ball again, and this time send heating energy — warmer, and warmer, until it's hot enough to smoke. Then cut the energy completely, and pull your tool back to recharge. Nothing more flows to the ball.
Reshape your tool into a tube once more. One end close to your center of consciousness — stretch the other end out to someone you know, wherever they are right now.
Perceive through the tube. What are they doing? Where are they? What are they thinking? Let it flow to you, and remember it clearly.
Now, if you wish, send a message through the same tube — clear and strong — to let them know you're here.
Pull the tube back to its normal size, and change it back into a bar. Put it away somewhere you can find it again.
Begin your process of Resonant Tuning.
Inhale slowly through your nose, drawing in fresh, new energy from all over your body, and direct the already existing energy up into your head. Hold the energy there for a moment.
Then exhale through your mouth, lips pursed as if blowing out a candle. As you do, imagine any stale or used-up energy leaving your body with the breath.
Again. Inhale fresh energy from all over your body, and direct it up into your head. And hold.
Now exhale. Releasing the stale old energy that still remains.
Do this at your own pace for a few breaths.
Now, begin to hum gently as you exhale. Let the sound vibrate softly through your throat, jaw, and the space inside your head. Don't force it. Just hum lightly. Let the sound carry tension away.
With each hum, you're allowing your energy to align and tune the instrument that is your body.
Breathe normally. You can breathe normally now.
Take a moment. Let your attention come back to your body.
Let your shoulders fall away from your ears. Let your jaw soften. Let your hands rest exactly where they are.
Take one slow breath, and let it go without steering it.
Let your body become weightless again. Nothing to hold up, nothing to hold on to.
And when you are ready, we continue from where we were.
At any time from this moment forward, if you desire to return to full physical and mental awareness, repeat the number one in your mind.
When you do this, you will return. Fully awake, both physically and mentally. Clear. Alert. Present.
And the more you use this method to return to waking consciousness in physical matter reality, the easier and more natural it will become.
But for now. Mind awake. Body asleep.
Before we begin the climb, know this.
You are always in control. You can return to full waking consciousness at any time, by either of two methods.
The first is immediate. Simply think the number one in your mind. When you do, you will return. Fully awake, both physically and mentally. Clear. Alert. Present.

The second is gradual. From whatever focus level you find yourself in, count slowly backwards in your mind down to one. This is the graceful return, and it allows you to descend through each state in turn, settling gently back into your body.
Both methods are always available to you. Carry this knowing with you as we climb.
Return now to full physical waking consciousness by the method you've learned. Think the number one in your mind.
As you do, become completely wide awake, physically and mentally, fully refreshed and filled with new vitality.
Begin your return to full physical waking consciousness. Begin it now.
I'm going to count now from three to one.
And when I reach the count of one, all of your five physical senses will be operating clearly, cleanly, sharply, and beautifully.
You'll be completely wide awake, both physically and mentally, and feel completely refreshed, and feel better in every way, all when I reach the count of one.
Your senses are waking up. All of your physical senses are waking up, and becoming more and more aware.
When I reach the count of one, all of your five physical senses will be operating clearly, cleanly, sharply, and beautifully.
You'll be completely wide awake, both physically and mentally, and be completely refreshed.
All when I reach the count of one.
Open your eyes. Stretch your arms and legs. Breathe deeply.
Return now to full physical waking consciousness as I count from twelve back to one.
Five. Begin to move your physical body.
One. Awake and alert. Welcome back.
Your body is still relaxed, and you remain at peace.
You'll return now to full physical waking reality as I count from ten down to one.
When I reach the count of one, all of your five physical senses will be operating clearly, cleanly, sharply, and beautifully.
You'll be completely wide awake, both physically and mentally, feeling completely refreshed, feeling better in every way, all when I reach the count of one.
When I reach the count of one, all of your five physical senses will be operating clearly, cleanly, sharply, and beautifully.
You'll be completely wide awake, both physically and mentally, full of new energy, feeling better in every way, all when I reach the count of one.
Wake up, open your eyes, breathe deeply, and stretch your arms and legs.
Become acquainted with your second body — the energy that surrounds your physical body. Take a moment to feel it.
Now notice your right arm. Its position. Your fingers, and the direction they're pointing.
Slowly, just through thought, stretch your non-physical arm out in that same direction. Further and further.
Reach for something familiar, beyond where your physical arm could ever reach. Keep stretching until you feel something.
Straighten your non-physical hand, and gently push against it. A little more. A little harder. Let any resistance give way.
Now reach for whatever's beyond that object — the one your hand just passed through. Feel it. Notice its texture. Take your time exploring it.
Now, calmly, withdraw your hand. Bring it slowly back to your energy body, back to where it started.
Now the same, with your left arm. Let it extend outward, in the direction it's pointing. Further and further.
Reach for something familiar, beyond your physical reach. Keep stretching until you feel it.
Straighten your hand, and push gently against it. A little more. Overcome the resistance.
Reach for what's beyond it. Feel it. Notice its texture. Explore.
Withdraw your hand now, slowly, back to your energy body.
From your special place, notice whether anything's changed since you were last here. Make whatever modifications suit you now. Invite any guides or helpers you'd like with you.
Now, an overview of the rest of Focus 27 -- places beyond your special place you'll have the chance to explore in depth another time.
Move your intention to the Educational Center. Observe what's around you. Notice the activities taking place.
Now to the Planning Center. Observe. Notice what's happening here.
Now to the Healing and Regeneration Center. Move in, and observe. Let yourself relax here as you take it in.
Now the Coordination Area -- dedicated to maintaining and managing Focus 27 itself. Gather your impressions of the beings and energies at work here.
Now widen your perception further still. Sense areas of Focus 27 related to things beyond the human earth experience entirely -- other systems, unrelated to it. Explore.
Give thanks for all you've seen. Make the intention to remember it.
I will leave you here now.
Stay as long as you wish.
From your special place, relax. Take a deep breath.
Consider your current embodiment in the Earth-life system. Your beliefs. Your fears, your loves. Your sorrows, your joy, your pain.
Simply observe all of it, and let some distance open up. Notice: the one observing isn't actually any of these things.
Now consider your self-image -- the one you've worked so hard to build, to maintain, to show to everyone you meet. Your body. Your education. Your job. Your country.
Observe all of it the same way, with that same distance. Realize the one observing isn't any of it. They're constructs -- all of them. See this clearly now.

If you feel ready -- if you're a last-timer, as Bob Monroe put it -- you need not remain in the physical earth-life system. Let your consciousness move, slowly, from your special place into the other areas of the reception center.
A long hallway opens before you, doors on either side. Move toward it.

Ahead is a large box, with a heavy lid. Place the totality of your experience from Earth inside it -- your embodiments, your beliefs, your fears, your goals, your unresolved desires. Thank them for their service, and leave them there.
Close the lid, and move on down the hallway, past the doors.
At the very end, one final door.
When you're ready, open it, and step through.
Give thanks for what you've experienced. It's time to return, to the Earth-life system.
With your Resonant Energy Balloon around you, let it float upward, and you with it, safe and calm.
Let it rise all the way to Focus 12, the state of expanded awareness.
You're floating there now. Perceive in every direction from inside your balloon.
Perceive upward, to twelve o'clock. Remember what you notice.
Now to your right, three o'clock. Observe.
Now downward, six o'clock. Perceive, and remember.
Now to your left, nine o'clock, behind you. Perceive, and remember.
Move your perception back up to twelve, where you began.
Now trace the path forward: from twelve down to three, perceiving as you go. Stop and observe at three.
From three, forward and down to six. Stop and observe.
From six, up and behind you to nine. Stop and observe.
From nine, back up to twelve. You're back where you started.
Now trace it the other way — twelve back to nine, nine down to six, six up to three, three back to twelve — perceiving as you move, slowly.
Relax at twelve, and settle back into the center of your balloon.
Let it float downward now, back to Focus 10, easily and calmly.
You're back. Let the balloon move inward, and reabsorb into you.
Relax, and feel calm and comfortable in Focus 10.
You are in Focus 15. There is no time here. Nothing familiar to arrive at, and nothing to hold onto.
This is not the void proper — that lies further ahead, at Focus 26 — but it shares its emptiness. No features. No orientation.
There is nothing you need to find here. Nothing you need to do.
Let yourself rest in the absence of anything. If it feels like there is nothing to lean on, that is correct. That is the state.
If something arrives — a shape, a thought, a shift in the quality of the emptiness — notice it. You don't need to reach for it, or explain it. Let it be there, or let it pass.
This may be the first time you have lingered here this way. There is no correct way to do it. There is only staying, and noticing what staying is like.
Stay as long as feels right.
